summary: Verified Stripe end-to-end integration in storefront checkout. Backend Stripe public settings, order creation (returns real cs_test_... redirect_url), and idempotent status polling all pass. Frontend flow (add-to-cart -> cart -> shipping -> payment) shows the 'Credit / Debit Card (Stripe)' option with data-testid='payment-method-stripe', clicking it reveals stripe-info-panel, no Demo Mode banner shows, and clicking place-order-btn on Review correctly redirects the browser to checkout.stripe.com (session cs_test_a1bgcuddGETPn0U1Gc560hc9j0tcj5rPMqbDaqKNPClEdXIEOnMmJwTqbp). Regression: cashapp/venmo orders still succeed; paypal correctly returns 503 (gateway disabled in preview); durango card path does not 500.
critical_code_review_comments: durango_payments.py is ~1531 lines — consider splitting Stripe/Durango/PayPal handlers into separate modules for maintainability.
get_stripe_status endpoint has no auth/rate limiting — anyone with a session_id can poll; low risk but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: None. Stripe test sessions were created (cs_test_...) but left in unpaid/open state — no cleanup required.
